content.user_title: List Artists in Your Recoup Roster
content.value_statement: A missing workspace can make an active artist roster appear empty. This skill checks local identity files and uses live Recoup roster discovery when needed.
actual_capabilities: Lists artist directories stored under the local artists workspace.
Reads artist names, slugs, and identifiers from RECOUP.md frontmatter.
Uses Recoup account and organization discovery when local roster files are unavailable.
Returns artist names with identity details instead of raw data.
Confirms the live account before reporting an empty roster.
limitations: Requires a Recoup workspace or authorized access through the Recoup platform API skill.
Does not add artists or modify roster records.
Does not manage files inside an individual artist directory.
Reports roster identity details, not complete artist profiles.

use_cases.title: Review a Managed Roster
use_cases.description: List every managed artist with the available slug and identifier before planning roster work.

use_cases.title: Inspect a Shared Workspace
use_cases.description: Check which artist directories exist and identify the corresponding local roster records.

use_cases.title: Verify Live Account Membership
use_cases.description: Confirm the authorized live roster when a new or incomplete workspace contains no artist files.

prompt_templates.title: List My Artists
prompt_templates.prompt: List every artist on my Recoup roster. Include each available name, slug, and artist identifier.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a simple roster overview.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Local Roster Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the local artists workspace and list each artist found in RECOUP.md identity files. Include missing identity fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when reviewing a populated local workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Check the Live Roster
prompt_templates.prompt: The local artists workspace is missing or empty. Check my authorized live Recoup account and list the roster with identity details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when local files cannot establish the roster.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Local and Live Artists
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the local artist identities with my authorized live Recoup roster. Report matches and differences without inventing missing records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced roster consistency review.

output_examples.input: List the artists in this workspace.
output: Aria North, slug: aria-north, artist ID: available
River Static, slug: river-static, artist ID: not recorded locally

output_examples.input: The artists directory is missing. What artists do I have?
output_examples.output: No local roster files were available. The authorized live Recoup account lists Aria North and River Static with their roster identifiers.

output_examples.input: Show names and identity details, but no raw data.
output_examples.output: Aria North, slug: aria-north, artist ID: available

best_practices: Confirm the active workspace and account before listing roster data.
Include names, slugs, and identifiers when those fields are available.
Use live discovery only when local roster files are missing or empty.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a missing artists directory as proof of an empty roster.
Do not invent artist names or identity values.
Do not return raw API data when a concise roster list is sufficient.

faq.question: Where does the skill look first?
faq.answer: It first checks artist directories and RECOUP.md identity files in the local workspace.

faq.question: What happens when the local workspace is empty?
faq.answer: It checks the authorized live Recoup account before reporting an empty roster.

faq.question: Which artist details are returned?
faq.answer: It returns names and available identity fields, including slugs and artist identifiers.

faq.question: Can this skill add a new artist?
faq.answer: No. Use the dedicated Recoup roster artist creation skill for that task.

faq.question: Can this skill edit artist files?
faq.answer: No. Use the dedicated Recoup artist management skill to work inside one artist directory.

faq.question: Does live discovery require account access?
faq.answer: Yes. Live discovery requires authorized Recoup platform API access for the relevant account.
